title: Long-Time Landau–Pekar Dynamics of Strongly Coupled Polarons
exact_target: Extend the strong-coupling Landau--Pekar approximation beyond the currently indicated quadratic time window.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004240 (OWR-17137-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/41, pp. 2541--2603. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 13.
Strongly coupled polaron dynamics (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The initial states, norm and time normalization must remain those of the report. Extending a formal ansatz or proving a bound on the same order-$\alpha^2$ interval does not satisfy the requested longer-time control.
